svg.title: Mushroom Glade — selected, cleaned design
svg.desc: Editable 864 by 1872 mushroom glade. Small outline spurs and shallow accidental notches have been cleaned while preserving deliberate pixel steps, the composition, all seven mushrooms and twenty-three spots. Eleven named layers, five flat colours, a two-pixel grid, and editable vector geometry only. No embedded bitmap or external asset.
